transformation_note: Gamma resolves the underlying through IBKR/TWS, requests option-chain parameters with reqSecDefOptParams, subscribes to paired near-spot call and put contracts, preserves contract-level quotes/greeks from those same lines, and interpolates a blended IV grid for the display surface.

collection.contract_selection_note: Sampled the strike set from 23 to 6 strikes across the configured 1.5% band to stay within the working budget of 49 option quote lines. Filtered 6 invalid option expiry/strike/right combinations using IBKR contract details before requesting market data.

surface_model_notes: Linear interpolation filled missing cells along the strike axis of their own expiry (0 interpolated, 4 wing-extended); 6 cells on fully unobserved expiries fell back to the term axis and were clamped to the observed envelope.

notes: Provider greeks are preferred when IBKR supplies them.
Gamma only solves or recomputes greeks from already-subscribed quotes; no extra option-pricing API requests are made.
